isinstance(value, list | tuple) is the sequence arm of the same recursive dispatch over an authored plugin-option value typed `object`. Plural emitted options exist (a sink `headers` list, report_assemble's rendered sequences) and pydantic hands back either a list or a tuple depending on the field's annotation, so both concrete builtin container classes are named — there is no single owned type to nominally check against. The check discriminates authored config shapes; it hides no missing attribute and no contract violation.
